T: Two men enter. One snack leaves.
D: Max ends up in Bartertown and its fight to the death arena.
P: Serve the mains when the Thunderdome match begins.
S: Medjool dates stuffed with goat's cheese and a toasted almond, dried figs halved, aged cheddar in shards and crackers, all laid out on a rough board like a market stall.

Strips of pork rind salted and dried overnight, roasted until blistered and shatteringly crisp, with a sharp apple and mustard dipping sauce. Score 800g pork rind, rub with 1 tbsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Pat dry, cut into strips and roast on a rack at 240C for 30 minutes until blistered, then rest. Simmer 2 peeled, chopped apples with 2 tbsp sugar and 50ml water for 10 minutes and mash, then stir in 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and a splash of cider vinegar. Break the crackling into shards and serve with the sauce.

Self-raising flour with a pinch of salt, butter rubbed in, milk mixed in with a knife until just combined, shaped into a round, scored, baked at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Butter and golden syrup.
M: everything in Bartertown runs on pigs

Pork shoulder rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, roasted low until it pulls apart, piled into soft rolls with tangy slaw and barbecue sauce. Rub a 2kg pork shoulder with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp salt and 1 tsp garlic powder. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart, then shred with the pan juices. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 100g mayonnaise and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Fill 8 soft rolls with pork, slaw and 150ml barbecue sauce.
the boss of Bartertown eats well

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary, rubbed with oil and salt, roasted at 180C until 58C in the thickest part, rested 20 minutes, sliced, with a fresh mint sauce of chopped mint, sugar, vinegar and boiling water.
W: Butter sponge cubes dipped in thin chocolate icing, rolled in desiccated coconut, jam and cream in the middle.
K: A quick homemade ginger beer of fresh ginger, lemon and brown sugar syrup topped with soda, fiery and cloudy, served over ice with lime. Grate 100g fresh ginger and simmer with 150g brown sugar and 300ml water for 10 minutes. Cool, then strain, pressing hard on the ginger. Stir in the juice of 2 lemons. Divide the syrup between 4 tall glasses of ice and top each with 200ml cold soda water. Stir and add a lime wedge and a thin slice of ginger.

s.how: Split 12 medjool dates and fill each with goat's cheese and a toasted almond. Halve 8 dried figs. Lay out on a rough board with shards of 200g aged cheddar and crackers.

Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour and a pinch of salt. Mix in about 300ml milk with a knife until just combined. Shape into a round, score and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until hollow. Serve with butter and golden syrup.

m.note: the boss of Bartertown eats well
m.how: Stud a 2kg lamb leg with garlic and rosemary, rub with oil and salt, and roast at 180C until 58C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Mix chopped mint with sugar, 3 tbsp vinegar and boiling water for mint sauce.

w.how: Bake a butter sponge from 125g butter, 150g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour. Cut into squares, split and fill with jam. Dip in icing of 300g icing sugar, 30g cocoa and milk and roll in 200g coconut. Pipe cream in the middle.

d.how: Grate 100g fresh ginger and simmer with 150g brown sugar and 300ml water for 10 minutes. Cool, then strain, pressing hard on the ginger. Stir in the juice of 2 lemons. Divide the syrup between 4 tall glasses of ice and top each with 200ml cold soda water. Stir and add a lime wedge and a thin slice of ginger.
